name: Flit
author: Erin Carter
description: An unseen moth circles an unseen lamp and the wall records only its shadow — one small winged silhouette whose projected size and penumbra blur swing enormously with its orbit, ballooning into a soft frame-filling grey breath near the bulb then shrinking to a sharp thumb-sized cutout near the wall. The wall carries the lamp's round throw with a bright tinted ring at its limb, and the shadow's penumbra fringe glows faintly warm.

params.label: Orbit speed
params.effect: How quickly the moth completes its weaving circuit of the bulb.

params.label: Flap rate
params.effect: Wingbeats per second, eased sinusoidally so even the maximum reads as flutter, not strobe.

params.label: Depth range
params.effect: How close to the bulb the orbit dives — deeper dives mean a bigger, softer shadow at the near pass.

params.label: Glow reach
params.effect: Radius of the lamp's round throw on the wall relative to the frame.
